auditor_claire: Hi team — fieldwork: for the Mar 14 incident please produce a single-page control map + proof pack for SOC2. Must prove: RBAC remediation (who/what/when), KMS promotion + cryptographic linkage showing post-rotation ciphertexts reference new version, immutable artifact snapshot with sha256 + signed manifest, and vuln triage summary. Please include exact S3 paths and short audit queries we can paste.

miko: We can assemble a compact pack. Top-level files will live under s3://redwood-evidence/incidents/6390012345/. Expect: terraform-diff.txt (redacted), iam-events.json.gz, kms-events.jsonl, manifest.json, manifest.json.sig, bundle.tar.gz, bundle.tar.gz.sha256, triage.md, deploy-log.txt.gz.

hamid: RBAC detail: rolebinding removal applied via terraform at 2025-03-14T09:04:22Z by ops@redwood.com. Remote-state diff exported to s3://redwood-evidence/incidents/6390012345/terraform-diff.txt. CloudTrail query we used (copy/paste):
```
filter eventName in (DetachRolePolicy, DeleteRolePolicy) and eventTime >= "2025-03-14T09:00:00Z" and eventTime <= "2025-03-14T09:10:00Z"
```
Exported matches -> s3://redwood-evidence/incidents/6390012345/iam-events.json.gz (event ids preserved).

miko: KMS: CMK alias/serving-cmk promoted to primary version 21 at 2025-03-14T09:12:03Z. We captured Encrypt/ReEncrypt CloudTrail entries with requestParameters.destinationKeyVersionId that end with ":21" for post-promotion writes and preserved x-amz-meta-kms-version:21 in object metadata on post-upload copies. Export path: s3://redwood-evidence/incidents/6390012345/kms-events.jsonl. Short CloudTrail sample (redacted, copyable):
```
{ eventTime: "2025-03-14T09:12:05Z", eventName: "Encrypt", requestParameters: { destinationKeyVersionId: "arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/zz11-yy22-xx33-ww44:21" } }
```
Sample ciphertext envelope metadata (captured on upload):
```
-----CIPHERTEXT-ENVELOPE-----
x-amz-meta-kms-key-arn: arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/zz11-yy22-xx33-ww44
x-amz-meta-kms-version: 21
-----END ENVELOPE-----
```

hamid: Snapshot/tamper-proofing: bundle.tar.gz copied to s3://redwood-worm/6390012345/bundle.tar.gz with Object Lock (Governance) retention set 365 days (retention-until: 2026-03-14T09:12:03Z). Adjacent file s3://redwood-evidence/incidents/6390012345/bundle.tar.gz.sha256 contains ASCII sha256. manifest.json lists filenames + sha256s and manifest.json.sig is a GPG signature (ops GPG key). manifest and signature stored at s3://redwood-evidence/incidents/6390012345/manifest.json and manifest.json.sig.

evidence-bot: auto-export: uploaded s3://redwood-evidence/incidents/6390012345/iam-events.json.gz (sha256: aa7b9c...), s3://redwood-evidence/incidents/6390012345/kms-events.jsonl (sha256: bb8c0d...), s3://redwood-evidence/incidents/6390012345/terraform-diff.txt (sha256: cc9d1e...), s3://redwood-evidence/incidents/6390012345/manifest.json.sig (signed-by: ops@redwood.com, sha256: dda2b3...), s3://redwood-evidence/incidents/6390012345/bundle.tar.gz (sha256: ee3f4a...) and s3://redwood-worm/6390012345/bundle.tar.gz (retention-locked). Presigned GETs (72h) created for the binder export.

ops-gpg-bot: Signed manifest details: manifest.json.sig signed by ops GPG key (fingerprint: E2F1 3A4B 5C6D 7E8F 9012 3456 789A BCDE F012 3456, key id 0xF0123456). Manifest includes a timestamp 2025-03-14T10:05:00Z. Public key available at https://keys.redwood.com/ops.gpg.

miko: Vulnerability triage: triage.md (s3://redwood-evidence/incidents/6390012345/triage.md) summary: CVE-2025-9999 in base image redwood/serving:3.2; severity high; mitigation = rebuild image v3.2.1 + rolling restart applied at 2025-03-14T09:45:00Z. Deploy logs at s3://redwood-evidence/incidents/6390012345/deploy-log.txt.gz.

auditor_claire: Two clarifying asks before I file: 1) paste the exact terraform diff lines with apply timestamp (redacted is fine) I can copy/paste into the binder; 2) paste the minimal CloudTrail Encrypt event (redacted) that shows destinationKeyVersionId ":21". Also include redaction notes.

hamid: Terraform diff (redacted, copyable):
```
- resource "aws_iam_role_policy_attachment" "svc_pod_readonly" {
-   role       = "svc-pod-readonly"
-   policy_arn = "arn:aws:iam::123456789012:policy/ReadOnlyAccess"
- }
apply timestamp: 2025-03-14T09:04:22Z
```
CloudTrail Encrypt event (redacted, copyable):
```
{ eventTime: "2025-03-14T09:12:05Z", eventName: "Encrypt", requestParameters: { destinationKeyVersionId: "arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/zz11-yy22-xx33-ww44:21" } }
```
Redactions: terraform-diff.txt redacted for account ids and any secret ARNs; cloud audit exports have principal identifiers redacted per evidence-redaction policy.

miko: Verified steps we'll include in the control map: 1) gpg --keyserver keys.redwood.com --recv-keys 0xF0123456 ; gpg --verify manifest.json.sig manifest.json ; 2) sha256sum bundle.tar.gz | compare to bundle.tar.gz.sha256 ; 3) grep -F ":21" kms-events.jsonl to confirm Encrypt/ReEncrypt entries referencing version 21 ; 4) match terraform-diff.txt apply timestamp to iam-events.json.gz eventTime entries.

auditor_claire: Great. Please post the one-page control map (plain text) here with: Control ID, Incident ID, What changed, Evidence files (paths + hashes), Audit queries (copy/paste), Retention/WORM details, Crypto assertions (GPG fingerprint + KMS key ARN+version), Redactions, Owner contact. I will drop into the SOC2 binder.
